HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS.py.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is a UI page class for the Android Smart app. It manages all interactions on the printer details screen, including camera scan, print photos, shortcuts, scan, print documents, copy, mobile fax, printables, print quality tools, product information, and printer information features. This class provides methods to interact with and verify the presence of various UI elements and tiles, ensuring robust automation and validation of the printer details workflow.
